definition: Christopher Granger Atkeson (born 28 May 1959) is an American roboticist and a professor at the Robotics Institute and Human-Computer Interaction Institute at Carnegie Mellon University (CMU).
details: Atkeson is known for his work in humanoid robots, soft robotics, and machine learning, most notably on locally weighted learning.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. A small key that opens a much bigger door. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. And that idea, made concrete, is Christopher G. Atkeson.
